conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: My loan EMI’s higher this month! Nobody told me about this!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the surprise, ma’am. Can you share your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s four six eight, seven nine three, one one, two eight. Why’s it more now?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Your loan has a floating rate, and the RBI raised rates. I can check for a fixed-rate option.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I don’t understand this rate stuff. Can you explain it simply?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Of course. A floating rate changes with market rates. I’ll send you a comparison of fixed vs. floating.
